spec_match.rationale: Implements the CSS Color 4 sample-code conversion path (transfer function + XYZ matrices from the spec) and cross-checks each space against the browser's native relative-color conversion color(from X <space> r g b) with getComputedStyle readback.

interactive.rationale: A colour input drives a four-row live table on every input event: JS-math coordinates, native serialization, and a numeric agreement verdict with a ±0.005 bound.

blurb_alignment.rationale: The card promises a working converter with the math shown and a browser cross-check — both delivered.

edge_cases.rationale: The rejected space renders 'declaration rejected' with the exact declaration attempted; legacy rgb() serialization of in-gamut sRGB is normalised before comparison; a DISAGREE verdict exists and would surface a real engine/math mismatch.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5162372125818880, the spec's sample conversion code and predefined-to-predefined sections.

conformance.rationale: Suite assertion relative-color-converts-to-display-p3-linear pins the native-conversion contract this page exercises (P3 red mapping to 1 0 0 in the linear space); suite verified executing on /conformance/.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 (chrome-devtools-mcp unavailable here): DOM dump shows three agree rows within ±0.005 (e.g. JS color(srgb-linear 0.2623 0.0116 0.0497) vs native color(srgb-linear 0.26218 0.011611 0.049695)) and the honest rejection row for display-p3-linear; both class screenshots read; CDP clean console, no overflow.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts converter-ran with the per-space agreement summary and a distinct converter-p3-linear-native / -unsupported-fallback branch.

design_system.rationale: Token-based chrome, captioned table, AA verdict colours on light background, focus-visible outlines.

accessibility.rationale: Native color input with visible label, semantic table with caption and scoped headers, aria-live explanation, agreement conveyed as text (agree/DISAGREE/browser rejects), not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: The wide table scrolls in its own container; CDP-measured no page overflow at 360x740 DPR3 and at 1280x800; both class screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Confirm the display-p3-linear agreement row on a Chrome 144 build
openQuestions.detail: On Chromium 141 the display-p3-linear row can only show the rejection branch. On 144+, the native column should serialize color(display-p3-linear …) and the verdict should read agree (±0.005) against the JS math for a spread of picked colours, including near-black ones where transfer-function precision matters most.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Wide tabular data scrolls in its own container rather than stretching the page.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The comparison table (min-width 620px) is wrapped in an overflow-x:auto container; CDP confirmed no page-level overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.query: communicating pass fail state not by color alone
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Pair status colours with literal text.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Every verdict cell carries words (agree with the numeric bound, DISAGREE, browser rejects this space); the same-colour chips carry no information not present as numbers.

summary: Inspection-tool concept: a real four-space converter running the spec's own math, cross-checked row by row against the engine via relative color syntax. On Chromium 141 three rows agree within ±0.005 and the display-p3-linear row shows the honest pre-144 rejection. Verified at both device classes with clean console.
